citation.title: Personalized positive end-expiratory pressure in spontaneously breathing patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome by simultaneous electrical impedance tomography and transpulmonary pressure monitoring: a randomized crossover trial

provenance.quote: Exclusion criteria included clinical FiO2 > 0.8, age < 18 years-old
included intubated patients with ARDS and a Richmond Agitation Sedation Scale (RASS) between −2 and 0, who were undergoing PSV

This was a prospective, cross-over, randomized physiological study performed in the general ICUs of the Maggiore Policlinico Hospital (Milan, Italy), Policlinico Universitario A. Gemelli Hospital (Rome, Italy), and Sant'Anna Hospital (Ferrara, Italy).
PEEPEIT-∆PL was defined as the PEEP which yielded the smallest difference between the percentage of collapse and overdistension
Dynamic lung compliance (CL dynamic), calculated as VT / ∆PLdyn
269 intubated patients with ARDS were screened, 239 were excluded according to exclusion criteria and thirty were enrolled from the 3 study centers
A cross-over randomized multicenter study was conducted in 30 ARDS patients
Intensive Care Med (2024) 50:2125–2137

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: All patients had ARDS by enrolment. Mean BMI 27.7 kg/m2, below the 30 threshold, and obesity was not an enrolment criterion. Timing is known only relative to enrolment (days since intubation/PSV switch reported as medians), so timing_subgroup is unclear per codebook ruling. The EIT-ΔPL method targets the PEEP minimising the difference between collapse and overdistension using dynamic driving transpulmonary pressure (ΔPLdyn), coded driving_ptp; no absolute end-expiratory Ptp target was used.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: COHORTS.md lists scaramuzzo_2020 and mauri_2024 as sharing Italian investigators but judged unlikely to overlap. Confirmed: this report studies spontaneously breathing ARDS patients on PSV enrolled December 2022 to December 2023 in Milan, Rome and Ferrara, whereas scaramuzzo_2020 studies controlled ventilation in a different population and period. No trial registration number is stated in this report, so the registration check could not be performed; overlap judged absent on population, ventilation mode, and period.
unclear_items: design.randomised: randomised order of PEEP strategies within patients is stated; no between-patient randomisation, coded true for the crossover sequence randomisation.
feasibility.n_placement_attempted/n_placement_successful: derived as 30 from protocol description and complete data; the paper does not explicitly report placement success counts.
citation.trial_registration: no trial registration number found in the report.
population.ards_definition_used: ARDS definition not stated in the main text (may be in ESM).
outcomes ventilator_settings/PEEP: the P=0.021 comparison test (paired t-test vs Wilcoxon) is not specified for this variable.
population.covid19_population: not stated whether any patients had COVID-19.

extraction_flags.general_notes: Physiologic crossover study; the clinically relevant outcomes (28-d VFDs, hospital mortality) are reported in Table 1 as follow-up data but no between-strategy inference is possible for them since both strategies were applied to the same patients. ESM Table E1 contains condition-level values for oxygenation, gas exchange, ventilator settings and hemodynamics that were not available in the provided full text; these may warrant contact with authors or ESM retrieval. P0.1-based and ΔPocc-based alternative PEEP selection results (10 [8–12] and 10 [6.5–15.5] cmH2O) are reported but are not a study condition.
